# LegislationPatch

> Plain-English summaries of U.S. federal bills (119th Congress), written from the official bill text published on Congress.gov and GovInfo.

Each bill page explains what the legislation changes relative to existing law, cites its primary source, and links member quotes to the Congressional Record. The site takes no editorial position.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://legislationpatch.com/): overview and recently analyzed bills
- [All bills](https://legislationpatch.com/bills.html): full index of analyzed bills
- [About](https://legislationpatch.com/about.html): what the site is and who makes it
- [Sitemap](https://legislationpatch.com/sitemap.xml): every indexed page

## Guides

- [Guides index](https://legislationpatch.com/articles/): explainers on how Congress and the legislative process work
- [Methodology](https://legislationpatch.com/articles/methodology.html): how bills are sourced, read, and summarized
